It seems that the retry queue is being blocked by 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table, and the connection pool has been exhausted since 13:40. Additionally, there is a read replica lag of 12 minutes.

Given that the malformed rows are a known issue (47 rows), and considering that the connection pool exhaustion might be related to the high number of failed jobs, I will proceed to delete the malformed rows from the failed_jobs table to unblock the retry queue.

I will also check the logs of the service responsible for processing jobs to identify the reasons for job failures while the export of the failed_jobs table is still in progress.
